intent: To illustrate that books are often filled with unnecessary filler material like stories and repetition, leaving only a small portion as actual content.

requirements.question: Must the clip explicitly quantify actual content as 28% or 28 of 100, or is a qualitative small portion sufficient?

units.claim: Actual content is only a small share of the book: 28 out of 100, or 28%.

basis.note: used with actual-content value to derive total 100

accept: Actual content makes up 28% of the book
Only 28 out of 100 parts are actual content
The actual-content share is about 28 percent
units.evidence: A labeled actual-content segment or bar with value 28 must be visible against a total that is visibly 100, or the 28 and 72 categories must jointly establish the denominator.

optional_valid: Describing actual content as less than one-third because 28 < 33.3
Describing filler as more than two-thirds because 72 > 66.7
Using a stacked bar or whole-book visual to imply the 100 total

g0_data_completeness.selection: all role=bar data rows; annotation rows excluded
